weapon.d:
Enables【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４, Min ２)】. Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
If a skill compares unit's Res to a foe's or ally's Res, treats unit's Res as if granted +5.
Grants weapon-triangle advantage against colorless foes, and inflicts weapon-triangle disadvantage on colorless foes during combat.
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X (for unit, X = 15; for allies, X = 5) and Special cooldown count-1 before unit's or ally's first attack during combat, and also, if unit or ally initiates combat and has weapon-triangle advantage, boosts unit's or ally's Atk by 20% and reduces foe's Atk by 20% during combat.
Unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４, Min ２)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit before the above, +1 (max ４; min ２; if unit used a movement skill that warped them, unit can move ２ space(s).)

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

If target ally has already acted, grants another action to target ally, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto.
If target ally can take an action, grants 【Perform】to target ally for 1 turn.
Also, grants【Draconic Hex】and "unit can move 1 extra space" to target ally for 1 turn (does not stack).
After Canto (including cases where action is ended due to Canto Control), if unit has used an Assist skill on the current turn, grants another action to unit, and re-enables Canto (once per turn; does not trigger when affected by effects of traps in Aether Raids during Canto).
Unit can use the following【Style】:
――――― Yours to Climb Style ―――――
Unit can use Assist skills on allies within 5 spaces of unit and within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit regardless of distance.
Unit cannot move and remaining movement granted from Canto is treated as 0. This Style can be used only once per turn.
――――――――――――――――――――
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance. This skill treated as Sing or Dance.)
【Perform】
After unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto; including cases where action is ended due to Canto Control), grants another action to unit, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto (does not trigger when another effect that grants another action to unit has been triggered).
After the above effect has been triggered, cancels Perform granted to your army (including Pair Up cohorts).
(This status cannot be granted to Heroes with Sing or Dance.)
【Draconic Hex】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on foe during combat and inflicts penalty on each of those stats = 5 - current penalty on each of those stats during combat for 1 turn (min 0; calculates each stat penalty independently).
【Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. Style use is disabled when unit is deployed using Pair Up or when unit is equipped with multiple skills that have a Style.

a.d: If foe initiates combat, grants bonus to unit's Def/Res during combat = 3 - number of foes who have already acted (min value of 1).
If foe initiates combat, grants bonus to unit's Def/Res during combat = 6 - number of foes who have already acted × 2 (min value of 2).
If foe initiates combat, grants bonus to unit's Def/Res during combat = 9 - number of foes who have already acted × 3 (min value of 3).

When unit is equipped with Sing or Dance as an Assist skill, triggers the following: grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+10, unit deals +7 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's first attack by 7 ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe, and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack); if unit has already acted at least once on the current turn, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit during combat.

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-2 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-4 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-6 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

For foes on the map whose Res < unit's Res at start of combat, inflicts Spd/Res-5, neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res, and foe suffers +10 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Inflicts Spd/Res-4 on foe, and unit deals +8 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

c.d:
If unit's HP = 100%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Smite】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Smite】
Range = 1. Pushes target ally 2 spaces away.

If unit's HP ≥ 50%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Smite】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Smite】
Range = 1. Pushes target ally 2 spaces away.

If unit's HP ≥ 25%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Smite】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Smite】
Range = 1. Pushes target ally 2 spaces away.

When Canto triggers, enables unit to use 【Smite】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 during combat and restores 7 HP after combat.
Unit deals +5 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
【Smite】
Range = 1. Pushes target ally 2 spaces away.
